original_test_intent: Verify all intended GPUs sustain a 12-hour burn workload at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, with the approved tool result and no thermal, power, XID, PCIe or platform fault.
original_method: Record GPU serial/UUID/BDF/topology, driver/firmware and burn-tool provenance; control humidity/dew point, cold-soak and apply measured +5% rails; start the approved per-GPU burn profile for exactly 12 hours with load floors and continuous temperature/power/clock/throttle/ECC/XID/AER/heartbeat telemetry; require the tool's approved PASS semantics plus independent health limits, then stop, warm safely and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator controls dry chamber/high rails, supervises all GPUs under burn and performs safe warm-up/restoration.
required_inputs: Command, matrix size/load floor and 12-hour semantics
safety_requirements: Control dew point and avoid rail overshoot
Verify cooling remains effective at cold soak
Maintain OOB/console access and preserve logs
Abort on temperature/power, XID, ECC, AER, heartbeat or moisture fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening
agent_execution_scope: May verify supplied identities/tool artifacts and analyze telemetry
Must not control chamber/rails, launch burn or decide DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve GPU scope, tool/profile and limits
Review independent health evidence and determine verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate every GPU's continuous load and health against synchronized chamber/rail/dew-point telemetry, not only the final tool string.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable GPU identity, tool provenance, per-GPU telemetry, independent aborts and safe warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One GPU's PASS or a tool process exit cannot prove all intended GPUs or rule out hidden XID/AER/throttling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold/high-rail conditions may affect fan control and link training; a tool's PASS may not incorporate platform logs or persistent corrected errors.
